verses.text: “Get up and shine! Your light has come, and the LORD's glory has risen over you!
Look, darkness will cover the earth, and deep darkness will cover the peoples. But the LORD will rise over you, and his glory will be visible on you.
Nations will come to your light, and kings will come to the brightness of your dawn.
“Look up and see what's happening all around you. They're all gathering and coming your way. Your sons will come from far off, and your daughters will be carried in people's arms.
You'll see it and light up. Your heart will race and swell with joy. The riches of the sea will come your way, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
You'll be covered in camels, the one-humped camels of Midian and Ephah. People from Sheba will come with gold and frankincense, telling everyone about the LORD's praise.
All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered for you, and the rams of Nebaioth will serve you. I'll accept them on my altar and make my glorious house even more beautiful.
“Who are these flying in like a cloud, like doves coming back to their windows?

The islands will wait for me, with the ships of Tarshish out front, bringing your sons from far away with their silver and gold. They come for the name of the LORD your God and for the Holy One of Israel, because he's given you glory.
“Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. I struck you in my anger, but in my favor I've shown you mercy.
Your gates will stay open all the time. They won't shut day or night, so people can bring you the wealth of the nations, with their kings led in as captives.
Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will perish. Those nations will be wiped out.
“The glory of Lebanon will come to you, cypress, pine, and box trees together, to make my sanctuary beautiful. I'll make the place where my feet rest glorious.
The children of those who crushed you will come bowing down. Everyone who looked down on you will bow at the soles of your feet. They'll call you the LORD's City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
“You were left behind and hated, so empty nobody even passed through. I'll make you a lasting glory and a joy for generation after generation.
You'll drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty. Then you'll know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
I'll bring you gold in place of bronze and silver in place of iron, bronze in place of wood and iron in place of stone. I'll make peace your governor and righteousness your ruler.
You won't hear about violence in your land anymore, or ruin and destruction inside your borders. You'll call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
You won't need the sun to light your day or the moon to shine for you. The LORD will be your light forever, and your God will be your glory.
Your sun won't set anymore, and your moon won't disappear. The LORD will be your light forever, and your days of mourning will be over.
All your people will do what's right. They'll inherit the land forever. They're the branch I planted and the work of my hands, so that I'll be glorified.
The smallest will become a thousand and the little one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will make it happen fast when its time comes.”
